title: The Florence paper
logline: Saturday. Florence's reply: the gull restored, and, by mistake or not, printed twice as big. Wood pins that page over the parody on the corkboard, where the Feb 25 page already is. Two pages over one parody.

panels.composition: The garage. The Florence weekly. WOOD looking at the strip in it: the gull, restored, and huge — the size of a panel.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man looking at a newspaper strip where the tiny signature gull has been printed enormous, a small dog

panels.composition: The gull. Bigger than the dog in panel four beside it.

panels.composition: The corkboard. The Feb 25 page over the parody printout. The Florence page pinned over that. Two newsprint pages over one stick figure. The gull, huge, facing out.

image.notes: Corkboard inventory: Florence's big gull, Mar 2008, over the parody.

notes: 'They fixed it so hard.' Two pages over the parody.
